name: proforma_mcp
schema: openferment_core (packages/core) — canonical Pydantic models; nothing is hand-written here

tools.name: health
tools.note: corpusSnapshotId is a sha256 digest of the corpus bytes read at startup, never a constant.

tools.name: list_cost_models
tools.note: DERIVED from data/corpus/scenarios.json — modelId verbatim, dims as the sweep axes, referencePoint as the scenario's point — never a copy. scripts/check-servers.mjs replays the derivation against the TypeScript COST_MODELS and fails if the two stop agreeing. Neither CostModel.evaluate nor ResultGrid ever crosses the wire: one is a function, the other holds Float64Arrays, and src/data/types.ts records both as unable to round-trip through JSON Schema.

tools.name: evaluate_point
tools.behaviour: refuses: no cost grid exists here. A grid is built by solving the plant at every node; interpolation is the cheap half and the solve is the half that does not exist.

tools.name: solve_plant
tools.behaviour: refuses: BioSTEAM is not wired up. No minimum selling price is available from this server.

tools.name: get_sensitivity
tools.behaviour: refuses: a sensitivity bar is two plant solves per parameter, and solve_plant refuses.

deliberateAbsences: No tool authors, edits or adds a cost model. A cost model's dims and reference point are the frame every MSP in the system is quoted in; an agent that could widen an axis could move a headline number without touching a single datum, and the change would look like arithmetic rather than like an edit.
